## Claims gates (binding, from the claims audit)
No hardcoded shipping threshold (read `free_shipping_threshold` from theme settings and interpolate `{threshold}`); no reply-time promise unless `reply_sla_hours` is set (render the timed variant only then); payment marks only through `SallaPayments`, never method names in text; the VAT line only when `vat_number` is non-empty; the trust line (CR, VAT, Maroof) only when all three settings are non-empty; "official distributors" wording only when `claim_official_distributors` is true (otherwise the neutral originality line from FINAL-content 1.2). Read settings defensively from `useTheme().settings` (keys may be absent on the mock store).
